pr.title: Modernize agentic workflows with gh-aw v0.88.7
pr.author: IEvangelist

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer.Tests, Microsoft.Entity... / Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: All 78 test failures in this job stem from the shared SqlServerContainerFixture class fixture throwing in InitializeAsync because the SQL Server 2022 Docker container exited with code 1 shortly after startup (invoking /opt/mssql/bin/handle-crash.sh). This is an infrastructure/container-runtime failure unrelated to the PR, which only modifies GitHub Actions workflow files (gh-aw agentic workflow modernization) and adds a workflow-script test file; none of the changed files touch SQL Server, EF Core, or SqlClient test code.
